newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyotaru shares up on hopes for restructuring plan.
newsitem.headline: Kyotaru shares up on hopes for restructuring plan.

text.p: Shares in Kyotaru Co Ltd extended gains on Monday morning, boosted by hopes that it would carry out a swift restructuring, traders said.
Kyotaru, which operates a chain of sushi restaurants, sought protection from creditors under Japan's bankruptcy laws last month in order to restructure its operations.
At 0041 GMT, Kyotaru's shares were up five yen at 45 yen, making it the second largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
On Friday, the Japanese financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that 10 companies, including major food processing firms and trade houses, were interested in helping Kyotaru's restructuring.

A spokesman for Kyotaru told Reuters later on Friday that a number of firms were considering offering it assistance in its efforts to restructure, but he added that he could not confirm the newspaper report.
